ns2:course.label: Modeling Dynamic Econ Systems
ns2:course.description: (ACE 365) Computer simulation modeling as a tool for studying the behavior of dynamic economic systems with an emphasis on applications of the dynamic simulation approach to problems in resource economics and management. STELLA, a computer simulation software, is used in the course. Prerequisite: MATH 234 or equivalent; ACE 562 or ACE 563 or equivalent.
